title: Sarbacher: craft at Wright-Patterson taken over by Anderson trust, MIT's Compton

tellings.quote: sarbacher says that uh uh there was a craft being held at rright Patterson and that craft was taken over by uh the Anderson trust

plain: A scientist named Robert Sarbacher is said to have claimed that a craft was being held at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, and that it was taken over by something called "the Anderson trust", a story also tied to a figure from MIT, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, named Karl Compton. Michels tells this himself, passing on what he says Sarbacher said, in an episode about a government research scientist who says he was abducted. If true, it would mean a recovered craft passed out of military hands into a private or academic group.
